_method: Each script pasted UNMODIFIED into the Pine editor on the UCT capture rig, added to the chart, then `graphics().dwglines()/dwglabels()/dwgboxes()/dwgtables()` read directly and mapped to bar dates through `graphics()._indexes`.
_theSentinelRule: ⛔⛔ `_indexes` HOLDS -2000000 FOR A DELETED OR UNPLACED OBJECT, AND THE PRIMITIVE STORE KEEPS THE DEAD RECORD. Counting the store without filtering reported 368 labels for Market Structure where the chart shows 14, and 117 lines where it shows 5. Every count below is LIVE ONLY; the dead tally is carried beside it so the filter is visible rather than implied.

market-structure-by-leviathan.title: UCT PARITY MS
market-structure-by-leviathan._verdict: ⭐⭐ EXACT. All 5 lines and all 14 labels match this engine bar-for-bar in the shared window — same date, same label text, same price, no exceptions.

trendlines.title: BTL
trendlines._verdict: ⛔ DEFECT, LOCATED. On all five lines this engine's RIGHT anchor is exactly TradingView's LEFT anchor: we draw the segment leading INTO the pivot, the vendor draws the one leading OUT of it. The pivot prices agree, so it is an anchor offset and not a maths error.

liquidity-pools._verdict: ⛔⛔ DEFECT. TradingView holds 90 lines and 45 labels across 2025-07..2026-09. This engine's newest SURVIVING line is 2025-04-09 while its series runs to 2026-09-11 — so ZERO of our 37 lines fall in the vendor's window. Pine evicts the OLDEST object at the cap and keeps the newest; we do the reverse.

4c-nyse-market-breadth-ratio.title: 4C Breadth
4c-nyse-market-breadth-ratio._verdict: ⭐ EXPECTED DIVERGENCE, NOT A DEFECT. The table renders on both sides. TradingView fills it from five `request.security` calls on NYSE/NASDAQ breadth symbols and shows '-1.07 NYSE' / '2.49 NASD' / '-128 ADD'; this engine has no such feed, so the cells are empty. Recorded so a future reader does not file it as a rendering bug.

_findings.evictionDirection: ⛔⛔ THE LARGEST OF THE THREE. Pine deletes the OLDEST object when a script passes `max_lines_count`/`max_boxes_count`. Liquidity Pools shows the consequence from one side (we keep only objects a year older than the vendor's window) and Fair Value Gaps from the other (the vendor kept 50, we emitted 212 uncapped).
_findings.trendlineAnchorOffset: ⛔ Trendline anchors sit one pivot span early, on 5 of 5.
_findings.forwardEdgeSessions: ⛔ An edge extended past the last bar advances CALENDAR days, not trading sessions. Seen on Fair Value Gaps (two weekend landings) and Inside Bar (two sessions short).

_bounds: ⚠️ ONE SYMBOL, ONE TIMEFRAME, 300 vendor bars against our 600, comparable window 2025-07-15..2026-09-11. Nothing here measures colour, line width, z-order or any raster property — only the objects' own coordinates and text.
